pages.title: Conductor of Rails
pages.text: Give a train a useful service; the toolbox suits its conductor and track extends the route.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use installed conductor creation and train assignment. Remote redstone operation and toolbox carrying are additional roles; the whistle must commit a valid train summon request.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Create and equip a Conductor. Use its remote redstone operation and toolbox-carrying role.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use a Conductor Whistle with a conductor-driven train. Summon the train through the addon's native whistle mechanic.
